astral.rancher_companion.solar.desc: Home terrain: the Overworld by day, from y 0 to 127. There it regenerates, its mood rises and its ability cooldowns are halved.
astral.rancher_companion.lunar.desc: Home terrain: the Overworld at night, from y 0 to 127. There it regenerates, its mood rises and its ability cooldowns are halved.
astral.rancher_companion.aero.desc: Home terrain: high in the sky, y 128 and up. There it regenerates, its mood rises and its ability cooldowns are halved.
astral.rancher_companion.underworld.desc: Home terrain: the Nether. There it regenerates, its mood rises and its ability cooldowns are halved.
astral.rancher_companion.deep.desc: Home terrain: deep underground, below y 0. There it regenerates, its mood rises and its ability cooldowns are halved.
astral.rancher_companion.end.desc: Home terrain: the End. There it regenerates, its mood rises and its ability cooldowns are halved.
trait.rancher_companion.hook_line_sinker: Fish bite about a third sooner for its owner within 10 blocks. Stacks with Lure and rain.
trait.rancher_companion.fallen_emperor.d: Piglins treat its owner as if wearing gold.
trait.rancher_companion.balm_salve.desc: Harmful effects inflicted on its owner are treated.
trait.rancher_companion.hide_seek.desc: Ghasts ignore its owner within 10 blocks of it. Fireballs already in the air still hit.
trait.rancher_companion.patchwork.desc: An item its owner would break within 10 blocks of it is restored to 25% durability instead.
trait.rancher_companion.stamp_out.desc: Fire inflicted on its owner is treated, with 5 seconds of Fire Resistance.
trait.rancher_companion.huddle_up.desc: Freezing inflicted on its owner is treated, and it cannot freeze for 5 seconds.
trait.rancher_companion.phoenix_heart.de: Instead of dying, it turns into an egg that brings it back at a hatchery after 4 days, traits and all.
trait.rancher_companion.cloud_stompers.d: While mounted, jump a second time in the air.
trait.rancher_companion.creature_comfort: Villagers within 10 blocks of it give better prices (+75 reputation).
trait.rancher_companion.night_watch.desc: Phantoms cannot spawn within 30 blocks of it.
trait.rancher_companion.soft_landing.des: Its owner, within 10 blocks, gets Slow Falling when falling more than 6 blocks.
trait.rancher_companion.undertow.desc: Its owner, within 10 blocks across at any depth, is lifted to the surface with Water Breathing on taking drowning damage.
trait.rancher_companion.hearty.desc: +3 hearts, and it regenerates everywhere (faster in its home terrain).
trait.rancher_companion.duck_cover.desc: An arrow or trident about to hit its owner within 10 blocks bounces off, as from a shield.
trait.rancher_companion.provoke.desc: Using the whistle to attack an enemy will provoke them, making them target only the drekki for 8 seconds.
trait.rancher_companion.barbed_coat.desc: 25% of enemy melee damage is returned to the attacker. Will always do at least half a heart of damage.
trait.rancher_companion.point_break.desc: Barding explodes when broken, damaging enemies in an area.
trait.rancher_companion.fade.desc: Enemies that target the drekki turn to another target for 8 seconds.
Endermen will not anger when its owner looks at them.
trait.rancher_companion.web_cutter.desc: Cobwebs do not slow the drekki or its owner.
trait.rancher_companion.marked.desc: Enemies attacked with the whistle glow and take 15% more damage.
trait.rancher_companion.live_wire.desc: In a thunderstorm it draws lightning to itself, unharmed. A strike doubles its attack speed for 10 seconds and gives its owner Night Vision for 30 seconds.
trait.rancher_companion.rewind.desc: Saves its owner from the void, returning them to safe ground.
message.rancher_companion.offer_away: Your drekki must be out with you
message.rancher_companion.died_ghost: %s has died... and returned as a ghost.
message.rancher_companion.died_phoenix: %s burst into flame and left an egg. Place it in a hatchery to bring it back.
screen.rancher_companion.drekki.reason.f: Far from its owner: -1 a minute
screen.rancher_companion.drekki.horizons: Unlocked by a Potion of Horizons
tooltip.rancher_companion.horizons: Permanently unlocks an extra trait slot when fed to a drekki
message.rancher_companion.horizons_had: %s has already had a Potion of Horizons
screen.rancher_companion.drekki.offer_no: It forgets this. It can want it again later.
screen.rancher_companion.drekki.ghost_tr: A ghost's traits do not work until it is revived.
mood.rancher_companion.miserable.desc: No regeneration from home terrain or Hearty, no one-off learning, 25% slower, no home terrain bonus.
mood.rancher_companion.uneasy.desc: No regeneration from home terrain or Hearty. One-off activities teach at 12.5%.
mood.rancher_companion.thriving.desc: One-off activities teach at 75%, and counted activities count double.
stance.rancher_companion.aggressive.desc: Fights any hostile mob within 10 blocks, and whatever hits it, hits you or you attack. Leaves creepers alone.
stance.rancher_companion.reactive.desc: Fights whatever hits it or you, and whatever you attack.
move.rancher_companion.recall.desc: Takes it off its seat to follow you. With another drekki out, it goes home to its hatchery.
move.rancher_companion.stay.desc: Holds its spot. It does not follow you, and fights only what comes within reach.
move.rancher_companion.follow.desc: Follows you, and catches up when left behind.
rancher_companion.ponder.stable.header: Building a stable for your drekki
rancher_companion.ponder.stable.text_1: The Drekki Hatchery is where an egg hatches, and where your drekki live when they are not with you
rancher_companion.ponder.stable.text_2: An egg hatches only under a roof: every block of a 3x3 over the hatchery covered, 3 to 10 blocks up
rancher_companion.ponder.stable.text_3: The two blocks right above the hatchery must stay clear
rancher_companion.ponder.stable.text_4: The 3x3 need not be centered: a hatchery in a corner of the roof works too
rancher_companion.ponder.stable.text_5: It also needs some light around it
rancher_companion.ponder.stable.text_6: Put an egg in the nest. After three days it is ready: right-click the nest to hatch it
rancher_companion.ponder.stable.text_7: The pup appears right next to the hatchery
rancher_companion.ponder.stable.text_8: Drekki that live here wander within 3 blocks of an anchor. The hatchery is the first anchor
rancher_companion.ponder.stable.text_9: Straw Bedding is an anchor too: the area grows 3 blocks around it. Drekki like to rest on it, and sleep there at night
rancher_companion.ponder.stable.text_10: So is a dirt path. Anchors chain: from the bedding a drekki may follow the path, 3 blocks either side, up to 25 blocks from the hatchery
rancher_companion.ponder.stable.text_11: Up to 20 drekki live at one hatchery. Use its screen to check one out, check one in, or release one
rancher_companion.ponder.trough_line.tex: The Drekki Trough holds food for drekki. Its low open side faces you when you place it; sneak to place it facing away
Troughs side by side that face the same way join into one straight line, up to 10 long
An 11th stays a trough of its own, and so does one placed around a corner
A line acts as one trough: food anywhere in it feeds a drekki at any part, and every plaque shows its diet
Right-click with food to put it in, or with an empty hand to open the trough
rancher_companion.ponder.trough_diets.te: Every trough, or line, holds one diet. The first food put in sets it, and food of another diet is refused
Seed: seeds, and crops grown from a seed
Root: roots, berries, and crops planted as themselves
A pup has no diet yet: what it eats most decides it. It eats from its troughs at random, so to steer it, give it troughs of only the diet you want
Once it is a fledgling its diet is set, and it eats only from troughs holding that diet
How drekki eat from a trough
Pups and fledglings eat through the low open side, standing in front of it
Each trough has a spot in front of it, one drekki at a time, so a line feeds many at once as long as each has room to stand
A blocked open side feeds no pup or fledgling there: keep the spot in front clear
Mature drekki eat over the wall: a spot behind each trough, and one at each end of a line. A lone trough feeds up to four
A meal is one item. Then the drekki steps away and waits a moment, so another drekki gets the spot
Drekki eat only from their owner's troughs: the player who placed a trough owns it
Drekki that live at a hatchery use the troughs inside their wander area, so place troughs along your paths and bedding
astral.rancher_companion.dormant.desc: Not settled yet: it takes the affinity of where it spends most of the first half of its first stage.
screen.rancher_companion.tombstone.title: Here lies %s
